newsitem.title: UK: TI Group seen continuing with Forsheda bid.
newsitem.headline: TI Group seen continuing with Forsheda bid.

text.p: The decision of Henderson Investors to reject TI Group's bid for Sweden's Forsheda engineering company is unlikely to stop the deal going through, analysts said on Friday.

Henderson, who hold nearly 13 percent of Forsheda, said they would be seeking a better offer than the 189 million stg already tabled but analysts described the deal as effectively done. "It's unlikely to stop the deal, They have undertakings for 64 percent of the voting rights from Agora. It's a done deal in that sense and this isn't really a problem," said one analyst.

British engineering firm TI Group announced the proposed acquisition of Forsheda earlier this month, a move which would make it one of the world's top three suppliers of polymer-engineered industrial seals in its chosen areas.
No-one at TI was immediately available to comment.
